socfpga_gic.h

GIC hardware abstraction driver interface for the SoCFPGA bare-metal software stack.

Constants
GICv3 security and grouping

Group values passed to gic_set_int_group. They choose which GIC group an interrupt belongs to.

GICV3_GROUP0

Secure Group 0. Typically FIQ.

GICV3_GROUP1_SECURE

Secure Group 1. Typically IRQ in Secure EL1.

GICV3_GROUP1_NON_SECURE

Non-secure Group 1. Typically IRQ in Non-secure EL1 or EL2.

Interrupt configuration

Trigger type passed to gic_set_int_type.

GICV3_CONFIG_LEVEL

Level-sensitive trigger.

GICV3_CONFIG_EDGE

Edge-sensitive trigger. The edge direction depends on the source.

SPI routing modes

Values ORed into the route word written to GICD_IROUTER.

GICV3_ROUTE_MODE_ANY

Any core. Bit 31 of the route word is set.

GICV3_ROUTE_MODE_COORDINATE

One core, chosen by the affinity value.

Return codes

Values the GIC functions return.

INTERRUPT_RETURN_SUCCESS

The call worked.

INTERRUPT_RETURN_ERROR

The distributor or redistributor address is NULL.

INTERRUPT_RETURN_INVALID_PRIORITY

The priority is in the range 0xF0 to 0xFF on a platform that rejects that range.

INTERRUPT_RETURN_INVALID_RDIST

The redistributor index is past the last redistributor.

INTERRUPT_RETURN_INVALID_ID

The interrupt number is not supported.

INTERRUPT_RETURN_INVALID_GROUP

The group value is not one of the three group constants.

INTERRUPT_RETURN_INVALID_SPI

The interrupt number is not a valid shared peripheral interrupt.

gic_enable_gic
int32_t gic_enable_gic(
void
)

Initializes the global GIC Distributor (GICD). This function enables Affinity Routing (ARE) and globally unmasks Group 0 and Group 1 interrupts at the distributor level by configuring the GICD_CTLR register.

Returns

0 on success; a negative error code if the distributor fails to initialize.

gic_get_redist_id
int32_t gic_get_redist_id(
uint32_t 
affinity
)

Resolves the logical Redistributor ID (GICR) for a given physical CPU affinity.  The GICv3 architecture requires specific redistributor bases to configure Software Generated Interrupts (SGIs) and Private Peripheral Interrupts (PPIs) for individual cores.

Parameters
affinity
uint32_t

The MPIDR_EL1 format affinity coordinates of the target CPU.

Returns

The resolved logical Redistributor ID on success; INTERRUPT_RETURN_INVALID_RDIST if no matching redistributor is found.

gic_wakeup_redist
int32_t gic_wakeup_redist(
uint32_t 
rd
)

Transitions a specific core's Redistributor from sleep to an active state.  This manipulates the GICR_WAKER register, clearing the ProcessorSleep bit and polling until the ChildrenAsleep bit acknowledges the wake-up.

Parameters
rd
uint32_t

The logical Redistributor ID to awaken.

Returns

0 on success; INTERRUPT_RETURN_ERROR if the redistributor times out during wake-up.

gic_set_int_priority
int32_t gic_set_int_priority(
uint32_t 
id,
uint32_t 
rd,
uint8_t 
priority
)

Programs the priority level for a specific interrupt. Lower values represent higher priorities. This writes to the GICD_IPRIORITYR array for SPIs, or the GICR_IPRIORITYR array for SGIs/PPIs.

Parameters
id
uint32_t

The hardware Interrupt ID (INTID).

rd
uint32_t

The Redistributor ID (ignored if the INTID is an SPI).

priority
uint8_t

The 8-bit priority value.

Returns

0 on success; a negative error code if the INTID or priority is invalid.

gic_set_int_group
int32_t gic_set_int_group(
uint32_t 
id,
uint32_t 
rd,
uint32_t 
security
)

Assigns a specific interrupt to an ARM TrustZone security group (Group 0, Secure Group 1, or Non-Secure Group 1). This dictates which CPU execution states and exception levels are permitted to handle the interrupt.

Parameters
id
uint32_t

The hardware Interrupt ID (INTID).

rd
uint32_t

The Redistributor ID (ignored if the INTID is an SPI).

security
uint32_t

The target group classification (e.g., GICV3_GROUP1_NON_SECURE).

Returns

0 on success; a negative error code if the INTID or group is invalid.

gic_set_int_route
int32_t gic_set_int_route(
uint32_t 
id,
uint32_t 
mode,
uint32_t 
affinity
)

Configures the multiprocessor routing policy for a Shared Peripheral Interrupt (SPI).  This programs the GICD_IROUTER register to direct the interrupt either to a specific CPU core (using affinity coordinates) or allows the GIC to route it to any available core (1-of-N routing).

Parameters
id
uint32_t

The hardware Interrupt ID (must be an SPI, INTID >= 32).

mode
uint32_t

The routing mode (GICV3_ROUTE_MODE_ANY or GICV3_ROUTE_MODE_COORDINATE).

affinity
uint32_t

The target CPU affinity (ignored if mode is ANY).

Returns

0 on success; INTERRUPT_RETURN_INVALID_SPI if the ID is an SGI or PPI.

gic_enable_int
int32_t gic_enable_int(
uint32_t 
id,
uint32_t 
rd
)

Unmasks a specific interrupt, allowing it to be forwarded to the CPU interface.  This sets the corresponding bit in the GICD_ISENABLER (for SPIs) or GICR_ISENABLER0 (for SGIs/PPIs) registers.

Parameters
id
uint32_t

The hardware Interrupt ID (INTID).

rd
uint32_t

The Redistributor ID (ignored if the INTID is an SPI).

Returns

0 on success; a negative error code if the INTID is invalid.

gic_disable_int
int32_t gic_disable_int(
uint32_t 
id,
uint32_t 
rd
)

Masks a specific interrupt, preventing it from being forwarded to the CPU interface.  This sets the corresponding bit in the GICD_ICENABLER or GICR_ICENABLER0 registers.

Parameters
id
uint32_t

The hardware Interrupt ID (INTID).

rd
uint32_t

The Redistributor ID (ignored if the INTID is an SPI).

Returns

0 on success; a negative error code if the INTID is invalid.

gic_set_int_type
int32_t gic_set_int_type(
uint32_t 
id,
uint32_t 
rd,
uint32_t 
type
)

Configures the physical trigger sensitivity (level-sensitive or edge-triggered) for a specific interrupt by programming the GICD_ICFGR or GICR_ICFGR registers.

Parameters
id
uint32_t

The hardware Interrupt ID (INTID).

rd
uint32_t

The Redistributor ID (ignored if the INTID is an SPI).

type
uint32_t

The trigger configuration (GICV3_CONFIG_LEVEL or GICV3_CONFIG_EDGE).

Returns

0 on success; a negative error code if the INTID is invalid.

gic_clear_int_pending
int32_t gic_clear_int_pending(
uint32_t 
id,
uint32_t 
rd
)

Forcibly clears the pending state of an interrupt. This writes to the GICD_ICPENDR or GICR_ICPENDR0 registers, dropping the interrupt before the CPU acknowledges it.

Parameters
id
uint32_t

The hardware Interrupt ID (INTID).

rd
uint32_t

The Redistributor ID (ignored if the INTID is an SPI).

Returns

0 on success; a negative error code if the INTID is invalid.

gic_set_int_pending
int32_t gic_set_int_pending(
uint32_t 
id,
uint32_t 
rd
)

Forcibly asserts the pending state of an interrupt via software. This writes to the GICD_ISPENDR or GICR_ISPENDR0 registers, simulating a hardware trigger.

Parameters
id
uint32_t

The hardware Interrupt ID (INTID).

rd
uint32_t

The Redistributor ID (ignored if the INTID is an SPI).

Returns

0 on success; a negative error code if the INTID is invalid.

gic_enable_interrupts
void gic_enable_interrupts(
void
)

Triggers the low-level CPU interface initialization. This routine typically configures the system control registers (e.g., ICC_IGRPEN1_EL1, ICC_PMR_EL1) to allow the processor core to begin accepting interrupts from the GIC hardware.

Returns

None.
